finding.scope: new extension attach default IPC authority
finding.detail: The pinned0.0.84 createBrowserWithInfo invokes browser.bind before returning. Actual coreBundle BrowserServer.start creates a discoverable local PlaywrightPipeServer and serverRegistry descriptor when no host/port is passed. Its connection exposes the prelaunched browser through the general Playwright protocol, independent of Eva seven-tool filtering, current gate and worker shared-tab validation. Windows seven-action tests inject browser/context and do not execute this attachment/bind path.
finding.minimalNextStep: Avoid retaining an added general control endpoint. Consider immediately invoking public browser.unbind before returning from attach and before worker grant validation, with synthetic actual bound-browser/registry/no-reachable-IPC/cleanup/failure tests. Alternatively demonstrate an equivalent bounded attachment path that adds no authority. Do not use owner browser to test.
finding.qualification: No new TCP listener was found. This is a concrete added local IPC/control contract and an unverified boundary, not a claim that a remote or different-user exploit was demonstrated.
